acs.text: WHEN the changed files of a pull request are given THE SYSTEM SHALL map them to surfaces through factory/surface- map.yaml, mapping shared code to every surface whose files import it and ignoring docs, specs and the factory
scenarios: AC-001 map them to surfaces through factory/surface-map.yaml, mapping shared code to every surfac

acs.text: WHEN a changed product file maps to no surface THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the derivation, naming the file and how to add it to the map
scenarios: AC-002 fail the derivation, naming the file and how to add it to the map

acs.text: WHEN a spec or an atlas entry names a surface that is not in the surface map THE SYSTEM SHALL fail factory doctor with rule surface-map
scenarios: AC-003 fail factory doctor with rule surface-map

acs.text: WHEN the QA runner's evidence is recounted THE SYSTEM SHALL report a retry after a failure as failed-then-recovered, a surface that could not be reached as cannot-reach, and a pass without an evidence line as a failure, none of them as a pass
scenarios: AC-004 report a retry after a failure as failed-then-recovered, a surface that could not be reach

acs.text: WHEN a surface the diff touches has zero journeys, or the runner's claimed counts differ from the recount THE SYSTEM SHALL block the report or report the mismatch
scenarios: AC-005 block the report or report the mismatch

acs.text: WHEN the recount renders its output THE SYSTEM SHALL produce one evidence comment and one issue body per failure with its transcript, and, when the runner wrote no evidence, mark every derived surface cannot-reach with the environment's reasons
